date.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO date-time. A timestamp without an offset uses local time.

date-style.description: Date detail. Defaults to medium when neither date style nor time style is supplied.

lang.description: Language tag for the formatted date. Inherits the nearest HTML lang declaration when omitted.

time-style.description: Time detail. Omit to show the date alone.

time-zone.description: IANA time zone for a timestamp. A calendar date keeps its day in every zone.

--ki-format-date-font-family.description: Default body font family for ki-format-date on a bare page.

component.description: Displays an ISO date or timestamp in the reader's language.
